evidence.description: The initializer receives accountsProvider explicitly, but obtains authentication state directly from EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared.
The visit-registration task directly reads the access token from the authentication singleton.

candidates.explanation: The provider directly depends on the operational authentication service through EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared. That service is not supplied through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Authentication status and profile are mutable instance properties without property-level actor isolation.
The public static shared instance exposes this mutable object globally without actor isolation.
These shared instance properties are updated by main-actor work, but the properties and containing class are not themselves actor-isolated.

candidates.explanation: Mutable published instance state is reachable through the public shared instance without a consistent isolation or synchronization boundary. Annotating selected update methods with @MainActor does not isolate the stored properties or their publicly accessible reads.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: The provider is an ordinary class, not an actor or a globally actor-isolated class.
The shared object's authentication state remains mutable and has no visible synchronization.
nonisolated(unsafe) explicitly opts the global shared reference out of concurrency checking despite its mutable, unisolated object state.
The object's mutable state is subsequently updated, with no class-wide protection establishing safe shared access.

candidates.explanation: The nonisolated(unsafe) shared declaration exposes an ordinary mutable class across isolation boundaries. The visible mutable state and updates make this more than an annotation alone, and no consistent synchronization or safety invariant protects access to that shared object.
candidates.title: Unjustified Unsafe Concurrency Escape Hatch
